items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 18 at 8:47PM AKDT until October 20 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Yakutat.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Monday to 10 PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will increase quickly through Monday
evening with the strongest wind gusts expected by early Tuesday
morning.
items.areas: City and Borough of Yakutat
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
Ensure boats and vessels are secure.

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued October 18 at 8:47PM AKDT until October 21 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph possible.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...From Monday evening through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...High winds could blow around unsecured objects and damage
property. Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will quickly increase overnight Monday
into Tuesday morning, with the strongest gusts peaking through
midday. Winds will begin to decrease through Wednesday afternoon.
items.areas: Municipality of Skagway
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
Ensure boats and vessels are secure.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 18 at 3:13PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Total snow accumulations of up to 3 to 6 inches expected.
Winds gusting as high as 40 mph. Rain likely mixes with snow
Sunday afternoon.

* WHERE...Kivalina and Red Dog Dock.

* WHEN...Through Monday Afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Since temperatures are
around freezing and there will be some rain, accumulations will
be slushy.
items.areas: Kivalina and Red Dog Dock

items.description:

visibility.

items.description:

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects and make
